summary: Iteration 9 testing complete - Contact Groups, Number Lookup, Personalization Variables, Campaign Failure Breakdown. All 25 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Number Lookup page with Smart validation (working) and HLR lookup (Coming soon badge), Contacts page with groups rail and bulk assign, Bulk Send with merge-tag chips and load-from-group, Campaigns drawer with per-recipient delivery table.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/numbers/services returns smart_validation (available_everywhere=true, cost=1) and hlr_lookup (status=coming_soon, cost=5, available_countries=[])
POST /api/numbers/validate with smart_validation returns full validation result including country, operator, is_mobile, historical_success_rate, risk_flags
POST /api/numbers/validate with hlr_lookup returns 400 with plain English message 'HLR lookup is not live yet' when numbers.hlr_enabled_countries is empty
POST /api/numbers/validate/bulk validates up to 5000 numbers, returns total/valid/invalid counts with credits_charged
GET /api/numbers/history returns last 100 lookups for user
POST /api/contacts/groups creates group, PUT renames, DELETE removes group and pulls from all contacts
POST /api/contacts/{cid}/groups replaces contact's group_ids, validates all groups belong to user
POST /api/contacts/groups/{gid}/bulk with action=add|remove modifies multiple contacts atomically
Contact model accepts extras={} dict for personalization data
GET /api/messaging/campaigns/{cid} returns failure_breakdown[] with code, reason (plain English), count
GET /api/messaging/messages returns failure_code/failure_reason for failed messages
PLAIN_DELIVERY_REASONS dict maps error codes to plain English (e.g., 'absent_subscriber' -> 'Phone is off or out of coverage.')
classify_delivery_error() function maps raw carrier errors to stable codes + plain English reasons
seed_data_creation: Contact groups and contacts created during testing for group assignment verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 complete. Client-side enhancements verified: (1) Contact groups - left rail shows All/Ungrouped/each group with counts, create/rename/delete group via buttons, bulk Add to group/Remove from group dropdowns, Add contact modal has custom fields textarea; (2) Number lookup - two service cards (Smart validation selected, HLR lookup disabled with 'Coming soon' badge), single number form with instant result card showing all fields in plain English + risk flags, bulk mode accepts pasted numbers or file upload, results table with Download results; (3) Bulk send - xlsx/csv parsing via SheetJS, 'Load from contact group' dropdown, merge-tag chips row (each header becomes clickable chip), live validation with red warning for unknown variables, preview pane shows first recipient's personalized message; (4) Campaigns - click any campaign row opens drawer showing stats, failure breakdown card (if failures exist), per-recipient table with phone/status/route/reason/tries/sent-at, Refresh button. HLR lookup is MOCKED (scaffolded, not live - returns smart-validation payload with telco_backed=false).
